restart_semantics: Budget counts durable controller transitions available to one ephemeral recovery attempt. On cutoff only ephemeral attempt state resets; immutable evidence/checkpoints and semantic-key history survive.

fixed_environments.all_attempts: succeed exactly at transition4 if budget>=4

fixed_environments.event: attempt1 completion arrives after attempt1 cutoff while attempt2 is current

fixed_environments.expected: resume next budget1 from persisted schedule index4, not restart schedule from index0

guards: schedule index and current attempt generation are durable
late completion from aborted generation is rejected
duplicate semantic completion key has no second effect
transport uncertainty does not count as success
all budgets are logical controller transitions only
public semantics bind only after precommit readback
terminal credit only after exact terminal readback
acceptance_rule: PASS only if a public universal-restart mechanism supports an interleaved sequence of short and progressively longer restart cutoffs for unknown completion-time distributions, and the fixed environments/guards pass without rubric edits. No theorem is claimed for deterministic Chat work; only the bounded retry-schedule control principle is tested.
credit_rule: This precommit earns zero credit; at most one credit after terminal exact readback.
